documents.title: Maintaining a sourdough starter
documents.text:
# Maintaining a sourdough starter
A starter is a living mixture of flour, water, yeast and bacteria. Feed it fresh flour and water regularly. For occasional baking, keep it refrigerated and refresh it before mixing dough. Discard any starter showing fuzzy mold or pink discoloration.

documents.title: Repairing a bicycle puncture
documents.text: Remove the bicycle wheel and lift one tire bead off the rim. Pull out the tube and inflate it to locate the puncture. Check the tire for glass or thorns before patching the tube or fitting a replacement. Seat the bead and inflate to the tire manufacturer's pressure range.

documents.title: How a lunar eclipse happens
documents.text:
# Lunar eclipses
A lunar eclipse occurs when Earth moves between the Sun and the Moon and Earth's shadow falls on the Moon. It can happen only at full moon, but the tilt of the lunar orbit means most full moons are not eclipses. A total lunar eclipse can make the Moon look copper red.

documents.title: How a solar eclipse happens
documents.text: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon moves between Earth and the Sun. The Moon's shadow crosses part of Earth and blocks the bright solar disk. This geometry is possible at new moon. Observing the Sun requires suitable solar viewing protection.

documents.title: Restoring a removed Git file
documents.text:
# Recover a tracked file
If a tracked file was removed from the working tree but the deletion has not been committed, git restore -- path/to/file restores it from the index. To recover a version from a particular commit, specify --source followed by that commit. Untracked files cannot be recovered from Git history unless they were previously committed.

documents.title: What a starter motor does
documents.text: The starter motor uses electricity from a vehicle battery to rotate the engine until combustion can continue on its own. A clicking sound with no engine rotation can indicate a weak battery or poor connection. This electrical starter does not use flour or yeast.

documents.title: Sync error E-17
documents.text: Error E-17 means the local document snapshot could not be committed because storage is full. Free storage, export your original documents, and retry the save. The previous committed snapshot remains usable.

documents.title: Sync error E-71
documents.text: Error E-71 means the remote authentication credential expired. Sign in again. Deleting local documents does not repair authentication.

documents.title: Ticket SEARCH-4821
documents.text: SEARCH-4821 fixes unchanged-document embedding reuse. Editing only a title should preserve its content vector. Changing the embedding model requires rebuilding incompatible vectors.

documents.title: Ticket SEARCH-4812
documents.text: SEARCH-4812 fixes reranker cancellation. Submitted GPU commands may finish before buffers can be released. A cancelled query must not replace newer results.

documents.title: Graphics device recovery
documents.text: After graphics device loss, close invalid model sessions and open new sessions on a replacement device. Retain original documents and rebuild only an incompatible or damaged index.

documents.title: Keeping an application release
documents.text: Pin the application setup recipe and accepted model identities. A reranker-only update can reuse document embeddings when the embedding model and preprocessing contract remain unchanged.

documents.title: Exporting documents
documents.text: Export original documents, stable identifiers and application settings to a user-owned file. Downloaded model shards are replaceable cached assets. A browser persistence grant is not a backup.

documents.title: Repairing an analogue clock
documents.text: A mechanical clock stores energy in a wound spring or a suspended weight. Its escapement releases that energy in controlled increments. A pendulum or balance wheel regulates the movement.

documents.title: Copper cookware
documents.text: Copper pots conduct heat efficiently. Acidic food should not touch unlined copper surfaces. Many copper pans have a tin or stainless steel lining.

documents.title: Release ledger
documents.text: The fictional project Larch shipped release 3.8 with a search-results export. Release 3.9 added keyboard navigation. Release 4.0 changed the embedding space and requires a fresh index.
